mapper.select: SELECT cs.id, cs.session_title, cs.started_at, u.nickname AS user_nickname, (SELECT MAX(m.created_at) FROM consultation_message m WHERE m.session_id = cs.id) AS last_message_time, (SELECT m.content FROM consultation_message m WHERE m.session_id = cs.id ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_message_content, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consultation_message m WHERE m.session_id = cs.id) AS message_count, TIMESTAMPDIFF( MINUTE, cs.started_at, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(m.created_at) FROM consultation_message m WHERE m.session_id = cs.id), cs.started_at) ) AS duration_minutes FROM consultation_session cs LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = cs.user_id ORDER BY last_message_time DESC, cs.id DESC

SELECT cs.id, cs.session_title, cs.started_at, u.nickname AS user_nickname, (SELECT MAX(m.created_at) FROM consultation_message m WHERE m.session_id = cs.id) AS last_message_time, (SELECT m.content FROM consultation_message m WHERE m.session_id = cs.id ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_message_content, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consultation_message m WHERE m.session_id = cs.id) AS message_count, TIMESTAMPDIFF( MINUTE, cs.started_at, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(m.created_at) FROM consultation_message m WHERE m.session_id = cs.id), cs.started_at) ) AS duration_minutes FROM consultation_session cs LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = cs.user_id WHERE cs.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY last_message_time DESC, cs.id DESC
